answer: Each identity claims one pearl bed, locks a 70-credit bond in the vault, and self-prices it under a Harberger tax: anyone may buy it at that price, so low prices lose the bed, high prices pay dearly. Each claim lifts the beacon floor, so bed k pays 30+(k-1) per epoch. A thousand fakes pay 529,500 per epoch, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 30 per epoch for one bed and exits with its bond; a rented-bed ring burns every bond.
